comment: Registered Raspberry Pi inspection targets for inspect_zone checkpoint inspections. Each target binds a surveyed waypoint (zone_id+waypoint_id, same whitelist as config/routes.json) to one Pi. `address` is the allowlisted network address live health checks may probe; `checks` are restricted to ping|tcp_connect|http_health with bounded ports/paths. `cabinet_id` is the physical cabinet the autonomy stack knows this Pi serves — the hardware adapter (ROVER_INSPECTOR=hardware) maps inspect_zone checkpoints to {mission_id, action: inspect_cabinet, cabinet_id} commands and validates cabinet_id against this registry. Simulated runs never touch hardware or the network — outcomes are honestly labeled synthetic/DEMO. cabinet_id values are placeholders pending the physical cabinet survey.
